correctness.rationale: The Clebsch model sum X_i=sum X_i^3=0 over F2 is a nondegenerate Hermitian cubic after extension to F4. All 27 geometric lines are F4-rational. Its 15 F2-points give Frobenius trace 5 on rank-7 geometric Picard, hence invariant rank 6. The six specified binary isotropic spans form rational lines with Gram determinant -2. Since an integral full-rank sublattice index d satisfies d^2 dividing abs(det) 2, d=1: they integrally generate the arithmetic Picard group; geometric Frobenius has A1 reflection. Independently recomputed six binary line spans, their intersecting/nonintersecting Gram matrix and exact integer determinant -2 without trusting package log. Also checked trace equation 15=1+4+2*5. The full 27-line count and identification require standard cubic/Hermitian geometry, not the finite determinant alone.
